[ALSA] hda-codec - Add ALC662 support

- Add ALC662 support
- Fixed no sound for [0x1631, 0xc017, 'PB V7900', ALC260_WILL]
- Fixed no sound for [0x161f, 0x2057, 'Replacer 672V', ALC260_REPLACER_672V]
- Add SKU ID for auto mode
